brief:
Europe continues military and security cooperation with Israel despite escalating political criticism of its policies, Shehab Wire reported. Some European nations have imposed sanctions linked to settlement activity or restricted weapons exports, according to reporting by RT.

The contradiction reflects a broader pattern in European capitals, where diplomatic pressure on Israeli government actions coexists with longstanding defense partnerships and arms sales relationships. Several countries have leveled public condemnations of Israeli policies while simultaneously maintaining defense contracts and security agreements. Others have taken limited steps such as targeted sanctions or export controls, yet these measures have not disrupted the broader military and intelligence collaboration between European governments and Israel.
